inputMethod: Copies of saved I033 JSON only. No predecessor calculator imported or executed. Current mass from triangulation.json.mass; older baseline.massBasis used only for its identified stock rows.
assumptions: New fixed blank/hole/bolt/spacer/web dimensions and polymer density are design assumptions.
Steel7850kg/m3,E200GPa,nominal355MPa are comparisons, not qualified assembly allowables.
Full paid blanks and full hex head/nut stock: no drilling/machining scrap credit.
Known placed-stock demand assigns full paid blank mass to its declared bookkeeping centre; trimmed material does not acquire structural contact.
New bolt under-head datum follows the frozen head/washer/plate sequence. Exact thread-root area and preload are unknown.

External circular spacer-end fillet volume is (a*a/2)*2*pi*(R+a/3). Its gravity is assigned to the root-circle centre as an accounting assumption; the exact physical fillet centroid is not established.
